alt: 孩子在海洋館水族隧道前看得入迷，家人拿著外套在出口耐心等候。
scene_prompt: 流連忘返 means enjoying a place so much that one lingers and forgets to leave. At a modern city science museum near closing time, a child remains captivated by a marine-life aquarium tunnel, watching colorful fish and sea turtles while a parent waits patiently by the exit holding coats and a closed umbrella. Sunset through the museum windows signals time passing. Warm, child-friendly wonder. Natural anatomy, aquarium glass and reflections plausible, parent and child grounded, coherent tunnel perspective.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration, landscape 3:2, delicate graphite pencil contours, soft watercolor and colored-pencil grain on warm ivory textured paper, muted blues and natural colors. No text, signs, logos or watermarks.
